title: Adaptive Heterogeneous Compression for Resource-Efficient Federated Knowledge Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2608.15660v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Federated learning (FL) enables privacy-preserving distributed model training but faces challenges from heterogeneous model architectures and limited communication resources at the network edge. Federated knowledge distillation (FedKD) alleviates model heterogeneity by combining prototype-wise parameter aggregation and knowledge transfer across heterogeneous models. However, transmitting gradients still introduces considerable communication overhead, while existing compression approaches typically apply a uniform strategy across clients and ignore their diverse model characteristics and resource capacities. To address this issue, we propose a heterogeneous compression framework for FedKD that enables each client to select a compression strategy from a candidate strategy set. translated_title: 自适应异构压缩用于资源高效的联邦知识蒸馏
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15660v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：联邦学习（FL）实现了隐私保护的分布式模型训练，但在网络边缘面临异构模型架构和有限通信资源的挑战。联邦知识蒸馏（FedKD）通过结合原型级参数聚合和跨异构模型的知识转移，缓解了模型异构性问题。然而，传输梯度仍会引入相当大的通信开销，而现有的压缩方法通常对客户端应用统一策略，忽略了它们多样的模型特征和资源能力。为解决此问题，我们提出了一种针对FedKD的异构压缩框架，使每个客户端能够从候选策略集中选择压缩策略。我们将压缩策略选择问题建模为非平稳随机多臂老虎机（MAB），其中每个臂对应一种压缩策略。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于多臂老虎机的自适应异构压缩框架，让每个联邦知识蒸馏客户端根据自身资源动态选择压缩策略，以降低通信开销。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an adaptive heterogeneous compression framework based on multi-armed bandits, enabling each federated knowledge distillation client to dynamically select compression strategies according to its resources, reducing communication overhead.
